text_block_list.text:
Марузенски runs her heart out and
secures victory
in the autumn Tenno
Sho, delighting spectators
and runners
alike.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Спешл Уик is overjoyed to have had
the
chance to compete.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her heart skips a beat when Марузенски
vows to
continue running in order to
have more fun races
like this one.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
